== Biography ==
'''James Glasgow''' lived at Torryburn, Fife, where the parish register names him as the father of 1 child baptised there. Their mother was [[Mitchell-58830|Jean Mitchell]], named in the same entry.

* [[Glasgow-4125|John Glasgow]], baptised 15 Oct 1689

No birth or baptism record for James himself has been found. His birth is placed before 1670, the year by which he must have been born to be old enough to father John in 1689; Torryburn is inferred from his children's baptisms and is not independently recorded.<ref name="OPR">Findmypast, ''Scotland, Parish Births & Baptisms 1564–1929'', Torryburn, Fife, Old Parish Register; the individual baptism entries are cited on each child's profile, for example [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=SCOT%2FOPR%2FBAP%2F2618062&tab=this John Glasgow, 15 Oct 1689].</ref>

== Research Notes ==
James and Jean Mitchell are linked only by the recurring parent names in the Torryburn register. No record of his own parents, birth or death has been found.

The named parent–child relationships concern the people in this one baptism entry. No record of James or Jean’s own parents, or John’s later life, has been identified. The before-1670 parent dates are estimates from an assumed adult generation, not ages stated in the baptism. The transcript remains to be checked against the original register.
